The man reappears on screen looking sheepish and scratching his head, smiling awkwardly at the camera. (9) The video ends with a promotional graphic featuring the man and woman again, with a call to action and a coupon code 'BIGECHO' displayed in prominent text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy male voice introducing the topic at a rapid speech rate, accompanied by an upbeat, fast-tempo electronic pop track. (2) A rhythmic sequence follows where a male and female voice alternate saying short Japanese phrases. Each vocal is punctuated by a bright synthesizer chime. (3) The female voice shifts to a higher-pitched, exaggerated whining tone, expressing difficulty. A comical 'swirl' sound effect or downward slide in the BGM emphasizes her frustration. (4) The male voice returns with an authoritative yet friendly tone, lowering the arousal slightly to explain a solution. The BGM continues as a steady, optimistic pulse. (5) A sharp 'ding' sound effect transitions into the main song segment. The male character's voice transitions from speaking to singing. The music swells with stronger percussion and bright synth pads. (6) The vocal performance becomes increasingly strained as the singer hits higher notes, with audible breath support and vocal tension. (7) A sudden 'failed' sound effect (low-frequency brass sting or record scratch) cuts the music abruptly. (8) The final phase features a lower-arousal male voice making humorous excuses, followed by the upbeat BGM returning for a brief outro.

It uses a comedic setup where a co-host finds Japanese difficult, leading the main creator to suggest his song as a fun learning tool, concluding with a performance and a discount offer.
